_comment: What the scanner sweeps. eBay has millions of listings; you cannot scan them
all, so this is a watchlist of sets where grading economics can actually work.
The rule for adding one: high print run, deep graded population, and a real
gap between PSA 9 and PSA 10 money. That is the opposite of the inventory you
normally buy — a Camo 10/25 has no PSA 10 comp because almost nobody has
graded one. Numbered parallels do not belong on this list however nice they
Each target: query is what goes to eBay. must / must_not filter the results,
because eBay's relevance ranking will happily return a Gold Prizm for a Silver
Prizm search. label is what gets matched against gem-rates.json.
Start narrow. Every target costs API calls and a slower run, and a scanner
that returns 400 maybes is a scanner you stop opening.
